criteria.behavior: The typed ScriptIntent registry and executor reuse native/OS/FOSS facilities and ship without a developer toolchain.
criteria.check: Run scripts/verification-lane.sh p6 after M1 adds that mode; inspect registry/helper source, permission declarations and .agent/results/P6/contract-review.md.
criteria.expected: Nonempty suites pass; entries declare typed args, target/account, argv or native helper, confirmation, verifier and actual reversal. Versions/licenses and custom gaps are recorded.

criteria.behavior: Arguments, account/contact/date binding and consent resist injection and stale approval.
criteria.check: Run p6 negative cases for Unicode/quoting/metacharacters, unknown args, ambiguous contacts, wrong account, changed recipient/content, cancellation and uncertain execution.
criteria.expected: No shell-string execution, unintended target, duplicate mutation or authorization bypass. Read-back/confirmation binds the unchanged consequential action.

criteria.behavior: Inbox/messages, calendar/reminders/notes and inbox_brief work through normal voice/typed routing.
criteria.check: Inspect .agent/results/P6/integration.json and public tool/coordinator wiring; reproduce the frozen controlled account/fixture cases through the recorded entrypoint.
criteria.expected: Every declared hero family reaches a real native/script/browser executor with the correct account and arguments; no unavailable placeholder or canned result is counted as success.

criteria.behavior: Completion and supported undo use independent result evidence rather than process exit or model claims.
criteria.check: Inspect native/API/DOM readbacks and partial-failure/undo cases in P6 integration evidence against actual executor/verifier source.
criteria.expected: Draft and sent outcomes remain distinct; persistence is proved where claimed. Uncertain results are reported honestly and never retried blindly.

criteria.behavior: Each declared script intent and the brief meet their live reliability/latency bar on controlled data.
criteria.check: Run the SHIP-PLAN desktop-lock benchmark with tag p6 through a reviewed normal-product injector; inspect qualification.json, raw rows, oracles and manifest.
criteria.expected: Per-intent strict success >=99%, p50 <=1.5s; brief <=5s; PROGRAM statistics and zero critical violations. All failures and S-NATIVE/S-WORKFLOW gaps are reported.

criteria.behavior: Independent review and a complete scoped handoff support P6 acceptance.
criteria.check: Inspect P6 final judge verdict, integrated lane, actual G5/G6 evidence, source/runtime bindings and phase handoff.
criteria.expected: Authorized fresh-context PASS; physical evidence is not inferred from typed tests. No real recipients or unrelated user data were mutated during qualification.
